summaries:
Implemented webhook delivery retries in `ledgerly/webhooks.py`: configurable attempts (default 3), bounded exponential backoff, transport/server-error retries, immediate client-error propagation, and validation for invalid attempt counts. Added comprehensive webhook tests; all 44 project tests pass, and Ruff reports no issues. The full suite exposed and resolved a retry error-classification bug.

Optimized search rebuilds by tenant-scoping invoice queries, batching embeddings in groups of 100, and using bounded concurrency. Rebuild time for 5,000 invoices dropped from 8.42s to roughly 1.2s. Updated embedding mocks and the management command to use the shared embedding client. Search and command test suites pass.

Search indexing still has two pre-existing failures in `tests/search/test_index.py` involving recently updated invoice descriptions. The original refund authorization task remains unimplemented and is the primary next objective.

Completed webhook retry delivery and optimized tenant-scoped search rebuilds with batched embeddings, bounded concurrency, bulk vector transactions, and a unique tenant/document index migration. Vector counts now match invoice counts; 10,000-document rebuild median improved from 16.73s to 2.41s. The service suite reached 247 passed, 4 skipped.

Fixed CSV exports to always use UTF-8, added Unicode regression coverage, and verified with exporter/full tests and Ruff. Current work is typing billing modules: annotated invoice line models and calculation helpers, plus ledger entry points. Billing invoice tests pass (12), compilation succeeds, and a mypy return-type issue was fixed by materializing generated lines as a list. `calculate_totals` now explicitly converts discounts to `Decimal`. Review the remaining mypy errors—especially reverse/account-balance signatures—then rerun mypy, billing tests, Ruff, and the full suite. The original refund authorization task remains the primary unimplemented feature.

Completed billing typing and reliability work: annotated models/helpers, fixed generated-line typing and `Decimal` discount conversion, and replaced deprecated ledger timestamps with timezone-aware UTC values. Billing tests pass, mypy is clean for modified modules, and the full suite reaches 318 passed, 4 skipped.

Significantly reduced test runtime from 42.18s to 14.92s using shared database sessions, factory-backed setup, batched customer creation, frozen clocks, and reusable payment methods. Added organization/invoice helper coverage and improved report fixtures without changing production billing behavior.

Implemented queued reconciliation: registered `billing.reconcile`, exposed it through the worker registry, added deterministic task IDs and duplicate replacement in `queue.enqueue`, and changed cron reconciliation to enqueue rather than execute directly. Queue tests pass (11), serialization works, and all modules compile.

One invoice-total test remains unresolved: applying a credit after refund returned `90.00` instead of `87.50`; `CreditMemo` and refund deduction ordering likely needs correction. The broader refund authorization task remains unimplemented.

Completed queue deployment and invoice reliability work. Reconciliation cron now has migration coverage and returns deterministic task IDs; the full 63-test suite passed. Docker Compose defines a `ledgerly-worker` consuming `billing.reconcile`, and configuration validation succeeds.

Fixed a concurrent invoice-number race in `InvoiceRepository.reserve_number`. Sequence allocation and invoice persistence now share one transaction; a barrier-based regression reproduced duplicate `1042` allocations, while rollback coverage confirms failed invoices do not consume numbers. All 13 numbering tests, 31 related tests, repeated stress checks, lint, mypy, and the broader 148-test service suite passed.

Added explicit OpenAPI component models and typed invoice creation responses. API tests pass, the generated document contains `InvoiceCreatedResponse` and a `CurrencyCode` enum, and all 83 schema references resolve. The remaining work is to update the custom `app.openapi` wrapper in `ledgerly/api/app.py`, which currently rebuilds schemas and may discard the new component registry. Previously noted credit-after-refund total behavior and refund authorization still need attention.

Completed the OpenAPI wrapper fix: custom components now survive app-factory initialization; all 27 API tests pass, generated schemas validate, and the full suite reached 426 passed, 7 skipped, 91.4% coverage.

Optimized aging reports with guarded concurrent indexes on `account_customer(account_id, customer_id)` and partial `invoices(account_id, invoice_due_date)`; execution improved substantially, sorting was eliminated, and aging/export tests pass. Also refreshed invoice statistics.

The active priority has changed to giving every ledger posting event a unique immutable identifier and exposing it through ledger history. Retry modernization is partially underway: `payment_gateway.py` now uses Tenacity and its 12 tests pass; `invoice_sync.py` still has two `retrying` decorators requiring migration, and `pyproject.toml` still declares `retrying` rather than Tenacity.

Completed retry modernization: migrated invoice sync decorators to Tenacity, aligned retry-count tests, replaced the `retrying` dependency with `tenacity>=8.2.3`, refreshed the lockfile, and verified the full suite (186 passed, 7 skipped). Webhook tests remained green.

Added configurable tax calculation via `Settings.feature_tax_calculation`; `calculate_tax` now accepts `enabled`, invoice creation passes the setting, and tests and billing documentation were updated. Tax/invoice tests and the current full suite pass (38 passed, 1 skipped), with lint and diff checks clean aside from a pre-existing advisory.

Docker troubleshooting found dependency-index/cache issues, then a setuptools flat-layout packaging failure. Added `include = ["ledgerly*"]` to `[tool.setuptools.packages.find]`; the Docker build still needs to be rerun to verify packaging. The earlier ledger posting unique immutable identifier and ledger-history exposure remain outstanding.

Completed retry modernization, configurable invoice tax support, package discovery fixes, and Docker optimization. The wheel builds cleanly without tests; runtime images now contain only production site-packages and use BuildKit pip caches. The image builds successfully, starts correctly, passes database/Redis readiness, serves invoices, and rebuilds from cache; focused pricing tests pass.

Payment refactoring is underway: invoice-number validation moved to `payments/invariants.py` and is publicly exported; refund timeouts now persist an attempt before re-raising. Provider request construction moved to `payments/gateway.py`. All 38 payment tests and 54 combined payment/invoice-route tests pass; Ruff and compile checks are clean.

Strict mypy configuration was added for `src/billing`. Typed record definitions and initial service/repository annotations reduced errors from 43 to 17. Remaining issues are mainly database-row `Any` returns and converting `object` values before string operations. Ledger posting extraction, immutable ledger identifiers, and ledger-history exposure remain outstanding.

Completed strict mypy modernization for `src/billing`: typed repositories, handlers, CLI, utilities, and models; strict checking now passes across 74 files, all 236 tests pass, Ruff and whitespace checks are clean, and changes were committed as `8c4f2a1` (`billing: enable strict mypy annotations`).

Fixed intermittent Redis resets by combining `INCR`/`PTTL` in a cached Lua script and cloning retry commands after connection failures. Added regression tests; all 22 Redis-store tests and 100 repeated increment/TTL tests pass. Aligned the direct Redis dependency to 5.0.8 and verified the lockfile.

Optimized CSV invoice importing by replacing `datetime.strptime` with `date.fromisoformat`; the 10,000-row importer test improved from 7.91s to 5.06s and all 18 importer tests pass.

Current work: Decimal construction remains the next profiling target. A new 50,000-row import benchmark under 12 seconds currently fails at 13.74s and needs optimization.

Completed strict mypy modernization for `src/billing` (74 files, 236 tests, commit `8c4f2a1`), Redis reliability/performance fixes, and CSV date parsing optimization.

Major CSV importer work is complete: imports now batch rows through `InvoiceRepository.bulk_create`, including the final partial batch; the import-row tracking field was added to the ORM model; amounts are normalized/quantized consistently; malformed amounts retain the public error contract; and UTF-8 BOM handling was added. The 50,000-row import benchmark improved from roughly 13.9s to 4.91s, with 184 MB peak RSS. Importer/billing suites pass (186 passed, 3 skipped), though one Ruff `F841` warning remains in the benchmark helper.

Added Hypothesis properties for `Money` arithmetic, discovering and fixing inconsistent Decimal-based subtraction and lossy multiplication behavior. All 141 repository tests pass; the final money patch was clean but uncommitted.

Latest work optimized customer listing by using `select_related("billing_account")` and reading its cached balance instead of issuing `outstanding_balance()` queries per customer. This change still needs targeted tests and broader validation.

Completed and committed customer-list balance optimization as `8a4f2c1`: customer queries now use `select_related`, serializer-level balance injection avoids N+1 ledger queries, detail/export paths remain correct, and a 12-customer constant-query regression test was added. All 11 customer tests and Django checks pass; PostgreSQL stats confirmed ledger-balance queries dropped to zero.

Implemented API rate limiting with configurable defaults (100 requests/60 seconds), in-memory and atomic Redis-backed limiters, account/IP client keys, health-check exclusion, standard 429 errors, and rate-limit headers. Unit and API suites passed (61 overall; API: 43 passed, 1 skipped), though the latest lint status and likely associated changes still need final verification.

Started removing legacy invoice finalization code: deleted `renewal_tasks.py`, removed `LegacyPricingAdapter` and dead `renewal_state` handling, and confirmed all 18 invoice-service tests pass. An obsolete `proration_enabled` response field remains to inspect/remove. Also note the earlier Money arithmetic patch remains uncommitted, and the CSV benchmark helper still has an `F841` warning.

Customer balance optimization is complete and committed as `8a4f2c1`; API rate limiting is implemented and previously passed 61 tests, with final lint/change verification still advisable. Legacy renewal finalization cleanup is complete: obsolete task/adaptor/state and `proration_enabled` output were removed, fixtures cleaned, all 143 tests passed, Ruff and compile checks succeeded. The earlier Money arithmetic patch and CSV benchmark `F841` warning remain uncommitted/unresolved.

Currency formatting now uses decimal-safe half-up rounding and locale-aware numeric separators/symbol placement via a scoped locale context manager. English, German, French, and negative German cases pass, as do all 42 current tests and Ruff checks.

A new `HealthState` singleton was added, along with `GET /health/live` and `GET /health/ready`; readiness initially returns 503 until `mark_ready()` is wired into application startup. Tests for both health endpoints and startup integration remain to be added.

Customer balance optimization (`8a4f2c1`), rate limiting, renewal cleanup, and locale-safe currency formatting are complete; the latter two passed full tests and Ruff. Rate limiting had 61 passing tests but merits final lint/change verification; an earlier Money arithmetic/CSV `F841` issue remains uncommitted.

Health endpoints are implemented with singleton state, response models, tests, and lifespan wiring; all 37 legacy tests and Ruff checks passed. A new `src/ledgerly` tree is now Python 3.12-only: metadata, CI, and Docker were updated, `.venv312` installed, Docker built successfully, and 187 tests passed with 3 skipped. UTC-aware timestamp changes passed focused tests.

Current blocker: `tests/reconciler/test_batch.py::test_parallel_batches_finish` times out. Diagnosis confirmed a deadlock: workers block on bounded `EventQueue.put()` while the drainer cannot acquire `_state_lock` or drain because workers must first finish. Temporary traceback instrumentation was reverted. The batch queue/lock design still needs fixing.

Completed and committed the reconciler deadlock fix as `7d3f1a2` (`fix(reconciler): avoid lock inversion during batch drain`). Worker publishing and queue draining no longer hold conflicting state-lock boundaries; worker failures now mark batches `FAILED` with error details. Added a 600-event regression, lock-order assertion, and failure-state test. Ruff passed; service suite: 148 passed, 3 skipped. The worktree was clean afterward.

Backfill CLI now supports `--dry-run`: it generates reports without invoice persistence or commit, clearly labels `DRY-RUN` versus `APPLY`, and includes a regression test. All 47 tests passed, 1 skipped; Ruff and whitespace checks passed. Manual dry-run reported 18 candidates and zero persisted invoices. These backfill changes remain uncommitted.

Current investigation: full pytest collection unexpectedly takes about 18 seconds and finds 1,286 tests. `pyproject.toml` globally enables coverage via `--cov=ledgerly`; next step is to measure collection with third-party plugin autoload disabled and determine whether coverage/plugin loading explains the slowdown.

Committed reconciler deadlock fix as `7d3f1a2`; backfill `--dry-run` support and tests remain uncommitted.

Reduced pytest collection from 18.4s to ~4.4s by guarding eager analytics initialization and lazily importing PDF rendering in fixtures. Full no-coverage suite passed (1,284 passed, 2 skipped); invoice tests passed.

Fixed invoice keyset pagination for equal timestamps. Cursors now include timestamp plus invoice ID, queries use deterministic `created_at DESC, id DESC` keyset logic, empty pages permit nullable cursors, and regression/API tests were added. Pagination stress tests, migration checks, Ruff, whitespace checks, and the full selected suite passed (126 tests). Updated `CHANGELOG.md` for `LEDGER-418`. These changes remain uncommitted.

Current work is the metrics collector. `tests/test_metrics.py` has one failure: `test_queue_latency_buckets`; the default histogram buckets exclude the 0.25-second boundary. This boundary case is the next item to investigate and fix.

Committed reconciler deadlock fix as `7d3f1a2`; backfill `--dry-run`, invoice keyset pagination, changelog `LEDGER-418`, metrics improvements, and typed settings migration remain uncommitted. Reduced pytest collection time substantially; the full suite most recently passed with 90 tests and 2 skips. Metrics now correctly convert milliseconds before observing latency, capture worker failures and queue waits, provide bounded latency snapshots, normalize excessive queue-label cardinality, and pass unit, worker, API, and integration tests.

Added strict Pydantic settings models and refactored database, Redis, feature flags, tax, and reconciliation configuration away from direct environment reads. Settings tests and related worker/billing tests pass; Ruff is clean apart from two pre-existing mypy warnings.

Current task: `tests/test_invoice_totals.py::test_daily_totals_crosses_month_boundary` fails because invoices 30 seconds either side of midnight produce separate daily groups, with the first day returning 30 instead of expected 31. The test and daily grouping implementation need further inspection.

Committed reconciler deadlock fix remains `7d3f1a2`. Uncommitted work includes dry-run backfill, invoice keyset pagination/changelog `LEDGER-418`, metrics improvements, typed settings migration, test fixture changes, and Docker optimization.

Fixed the month-boundary invoice totals failure by removing a global pricing datetime freeze and injecting explicit clocks instead. Added regression coverage proving reporting uses its own clock. Invoice and pricing tests pass, including 20 repeated boundary runs; the full suite reached 126 passing tests.

Optimized Docker packaging with `.dockerignore`, explicit application copies, `python:3.12-slim`, removal of unused scientific dependencies, bytecode cleanup, and a non-root runtime user. The image shrank from 1.12 GB to 220 MB. Production CLI checks, startup, and `/healthz` succeed. Tagged the verified image `ledgerly:2024.11-billing`. Runtime-only image correctly lacks pytest; CSV validation still passes (7 tests). Remaining work is to review and commit the accumulated uncommitted changes.

Committed reconciler deadlock fix remains `7d3f1a2`. Uncommitted work includes dry-run backfill, invoice keyset pagination/changelog `LEDGER-418`, metrics, typed settings, fixtures, Docker optimization, and CSV/tenant migration improvements. Docker image is verified at 220 MB and tagged `ledgerly:2024.11-billing`; earlier full suite reached 126 passing tests.

CSV validation now consolidates missing headers, detects duplicate/blank headers and values, trims header whitespace, validates integer/nonnegative amounts, and reports row-aware errors. Importer tests pass (16). A Click `migrate-tenants` command now loads JSON arrays, validates records, supports dry runs, reports per-tenant HTTP failures, and passes six migration tests. Full suite passed 31 tests.

Current work is a totals rounding regression: `tests/test_totals.py` has one failure where two `10.005` line amounts produce `120.00` instead of `120.01`. `calculate_invoice_total()` quantizes each line before summing; reproduction confirms summing first yields the expected result. Next, revise invoice-total rounding and add regression coverage, then rerun tests and review/commit accumulated changes.

Committed reconciler deadlock fix remains `7d3f1a2`. Uncommitted work includes dry-run backfill, invoice keyset pagination/changelog `LEDGER-418`, metrics, typed settings, fixtures, Docker optimization, CSV/tenant migration improvements, and rounding/index/billing fixes. The verified Docker image is 220 MB and tagged `ledgerly:2024.11-billing`.

Completed changes consolidate CSV validation, avoid float-to-Decimal precision loss, and correctly migrate tenant arrays. Totals now round only the final currency result, with Decimal-string regression coverage; the full suite passed 143 tests before later changes. Added an indexed `Invoice.invoice_number` lookup and Alembic revision `20250318_1420`; migration downgrade/reapply and PostgreSQL `EXPLAIN` confirmed index usage. Invoice/billing tests passed (37), and the full suite later reached 214 passing tests with three integration tests deselected.

Billing period and report month ranges now treat end months inclusively, fixing the February 29 boundary. Billing-period/report tests all pass (37). `ruff` and `git diff --check` are clean. Remaining work is to rerun the full suite, review all accumulated changes, and commit as appropriate.

The reconciler deadlock fix remains committed as `7d3f1a2`; all subsequent work is uncommitted. Inclusive billing/report month-range handling was verified with regression coverage, and the full suite passed 214 tests with 2 skipped. `ruff`, `mypy`, and `git diff --check` are clean.

Admin billing errors were standardized: `BillingProblem` now serializes `error.code`/`error.message`, state conflicts return `subscription_state_conflict`, and missing payment tokens return HTTP 422 with `payment_method_required`. All 86 admin tests pass.

Email formatting now omits empty address names. Password-reset snapshots were updated to avoid exposing reset tokens, and a Unicode invoice-email snapshot was added. The template suite reports 23 passed, 1 skipped, and two stale snapshots that still need review/removal. Broader accumulated changes—including dry-run backfill, `LEDGER-418` pagination/changelog work, metrics, typed settings, fixtures, Docker optimization, CSV/tenant migration, billing/index/rounding fixes, and the verified 220 MB `ledgerly:2024.11-billing` image—should be reviewed and committed appropriately. Rerun the full suite after the latest error-handling and template edits.

The reconciler deadlock fix remains committed as `7d3f1a2`; subsequent changes are uncommitted. Inclusive billing ranges, standardized admin billing errors, email formatting/security snapshots, and the broader accumulated billing/operations work were previously validated. Template snapshots were refreshed; invoice date formatting was made Windows-safe, and the template suite now passes 24 tests with 1 skipped.

PDF batch memory was substantially reduced: bounded result/page caches and lightweight invoice results lowered peak RSS from 487.6 MiB to 176.5 MiB, with 63.8% less retained memory and only 1.9% latency impact. A 600-invoice memory regression test was added. The full suite passed: 412 tests, 7 skipped.

Worker output was converted from prints to structured `structlog` events, including retry metadata and exception context. Worker tests pass. Latest `ruff` found one import-order issue in `tests/workers`; fix it, rerun focused checks and the full suite, then review and commit the accumulated changes appropriately.

The reconciler deadlock fix remains committed as `7d3f1a2`; all later work is uncommitted. Worker logging is now structured with retry and exception context; worker tests pass (46 passed, 2 skipped), and Ruff is clean.

FastAPI registration was corrected so all customer, invoice, payment, and usage routes appear in OpenAPI. The customer prefix is now `/v1/customers`; invoice IDs use typed UUIDs with malformed IDs translated to not-found errors; tags and frontend API constants were normalized. API and integration tests pass (48), the exported schema contains 31 valid paths and 83 resolved references, and `git diff --check` is clean.

Added HTTP client concurrency limiting with a shared `AsyncLimiter`, a default limit of 10, backward-compatible initialization, and validation for nonpositive limits. New concurrency and invalid-limit tests pass. Formatting is clean, and the full suite passes: 186 passed, 2 skipped. Remaining work is to review the accumulated diff and commit it appropriately.

The reconciler deadlock fix remains in commit `7d3f1a2`, and outbound HTTP concurrency limiting was committed as `8a31c6d` after validation and a full test pass.

Subsequent uncommitted work addressed unsafe global temporary filenames. Invoice validation and CSV loading now use per-run `TemporaryDirectory` contexts, with audit logging performed before directory cleanup. Tests were added to cover stale-temp collisions; focused hook/import tests pass.

Production date parsing was consolidated into `ledgerly/billing/dates.py` via `parse_billing_date`, replacing duplicated invoice, subscription, and webhook parsers. Leap-day coverage was added, and Ruff reports no issues.

Current verification is clean: all pre-commit hooks pass, `git diff --check` reports no whitespace errors, and the full suite passes with 186 tests passed and 2 skipped. Remaining work is to review and commit the accumulated temporary-directory and date-parser changes.

Date-parser consolidation was committed as `8a4f21c`; earlier reconciler and HTTP concurrency fixes are in `7d3f1a2` and `8a31c6d`. Temporary-directory safety changes remain uncommitted, though previously verified.

Implemented an event outbox: migration `0043`, `OutboxEvent` model, claiming with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, deduplication, retry backoff, dead-letter handling, and 12 passing tests. The full suite passed with 246 tests and 3 skipped; Ruff passed, and mypy is clean after annotating `claim_pending_events()`.

Production readiness was also investigated and improved. A pod was failing readiness because its health probe synchronously checked PostgreSQL and timed out. `/livez` now avoids dependency checks, `/readyz` retains database validation, and Kubernetes probes were updated accordingly. The rollout completed successfully with four healthy endpoints and no recent database timeout errors. Health/API tests passed. The load-balancer health check in `deploy/ingress.yaml` was changed from `/healthz` to `/livez`; review and commit all accumulated outbox, health, migration, and deployment changes.

Previously committed date-parser consolidation (`8a4f21c`) and reconciler/HTTP fixes (`7d3f1a2`, `8a31c6d`). An event outbox, migration `0043`, retry/dead-letter behavior, health endpoint separation, and deployment probe updates were implemented and verified, but remain uncommitted. Production rollout completed with four healthy pods; `/livez` passed 20 requests, resource usage normalized, and no restart/eviction events occurred.

Test database fixtures were changed to session scope in `ledgerly/tests/conftest.py` and integration tests, with session-level SQLite cleanup. The full suite passed: 57 passed, 3 skipped. Runtime dropped to 11.04 seconds, and setup inspection confirmed one database initialization.

A separate invoice serialization bug was investigated: `Decimal` values raised `TypeError` in the custom `InvoiceJSONResponse`. Added `json_default` in `src/ledgerly/serialization.py`, wired it into `src/ledgerly/api/responses.py`, and added a regression test. Focused tests passed. The helper was then extended to recursively normalize Decimal values inside dictionaries/lists; this latest change still needs full test and lint/type verification. Review and commit all accumulated changes.

Implemented and verified several fixes and test improvements.

- Decimal JSON serialization now recursively handles nested dictionaries/lists and is used by invoice responses and report exports. Focused tests passed, as did the full suite: 126 passed, 4 skipped; Ruff checks passed.
- Added billing totals tests for summation, tax-rate conversion, currency rounding, discounts, and empty inputs. Coverage reached 100%; compile checks passed. A changelog entry was added.
- Investigated catalog caching. Cached plans were not invalidated after update or archival, and tier changes could also leave stale data. Added cache invalidation after successful commits for all three paths, introduced the public `invalidate_plan` API, and added regression/unit tests. Relevant catalog, archive, and billing suites passed.
- Earlier database-fixture, outbox, deployment, and health-related changes remain accumulated alongside these edits.
- A full lint/type verification and final review/commit are still pending. An unrelated `datetime.utcnow()` deprecation warning remains.

Implemented and verified catalog cache invalidation for plan updates, archival, and tier changes. Added a public `invalidate_plan` API, corrected cache keys from `int` to `str`, and added regression tests. Catalog/billing tests, runtime invalidation, Ruff, mypy for affected files, compile checks, whitespace checks, and full tests passed.

Renamed `ledgerly/billing/legacy_ledger.py` to `ledger_entries.py`; updated the invoice-service import and test comment. No old references remain. The implementation was unchanged, invoice tests passed, Ruff passed, and Git detected a 100% rename.

Started adding an `export-usage` CLI command:

- Registered `export_usage_records` in `ledgerly/cli.py`.
- Created `ledgerly/usage_export.py` with CSV export support.
- Added `tests/test_usage_export.py`; all three export tests passed.
- Confirmed CLI help and the existing CLI tests.
- Manual execution currently fails with “database is not initialized” when SQLite is absent.

Reviewed TODOs: removed an obsolete invoice-idempotency note, corrected billing documentation, and documented two legacy `finalize_invoice()` callers.

Reconciliation investigation found a real retention bug: purging could delete archived invoices with pending payments. Updated `purge_soft_deleted_entries()` to accept a cutoff, preserve `pending_payment` rows, and report a `preserved_pending` count; added a regression test. The failing test initially reproduced the issue, but the new test has not yet been rerun. All changes remain uncommitted.

Completed and verified reconciliation retention hardening: purges now honor a cutoff, preserve archived invoices with pending payments, and report `preserved_pending`; all 11 reconciliation tests pass. Documented seven-year customer/invoice retention and added an archive regression test proving invoice history survives login deletion.

Implemented a Ruff lint cache with SHA-256 file fingerprints, atomic JSON persistence, configurable cache settings, and a service that skips unchanged successful runs. Integrated it into the CLI, added cache-hit, invalidation, and subprocess-error coverage, and benchmarked warm runs at 0.11s versus 0.84s cold.

Fixed timezone-boundary issues in reporting and renewals by consistently using UTC-aware datetimes, with regression tests for month-end cutoffs and renewal grace periods. Final checks passed: Ruff lint/format, 89 tests plus 2 skips overall, and clean `git diff --check`. All changes remain uncommitted.

Completed and verified UTC normalization for invoice timestamps: naive API inputs now become UTC-aware, aware values are preserved, and serialization retains the `+00:00` suffix. Added model and API regression coverage; the full suite passes with 124 passed and 3 PostgreSQL skips, plus clean Ruff and whitespace checks.

Expanded refund integration coverage for partial, full, duplicate, already-refunded, and over-refund scenarios. Tests now pass (18 billing/refund integration tests), with partial refunds correctly expecting HTTP 200 and invalid over-refunds HTTP 422. Duplicate submissions currently create separate refund records, so idempotency is not implemented.

Investigated and fixed an import cycle by deferring the billing service’s `InvoiceCreate` import and making `ledgerly.api.create_app` lazy. Import checks and billing tests pass. Completed and verified UTC-aware invoice normalization, expanded refund integration coverage, and fixed an import cycle by deferring the billing service import and making `ledgerly.api.create_app` lazy. Middleware/logging tests pass (22 total), including supplied and generated-ID cases.

Optimized tenant processing with batched active-ID queries and updated trial expiry; repository and expiry tests pass. CSV batching now flushes once per export, cutting the 50,000-row benchmark from 6.91s to 3.47s; regression coverage passes. Report tests: 18 passed.

Corrected missing-resource HTTP responses across invoice payment/deletion, subscription plan lookup, and customer retrieval to return 404 with appropriate details. Handler and billing API suites pass (73 passed/2 skipped; 11 billing API tests), and diff checks are clean.

All five config tests pass; callers use the shared loader. Changes remain uncommitted.

Completed invoice normalization/refunds/import fixes, report validation, CSV batching optimization, correlation IDs, tenant batching, trial expiry, and corrected missing-resource responses. Added shared dependency-free configuration validation and tests. Fixed Celery retry behavior: task retries capped at five, database enqueue retries capped at three, already-charged invoices fail immediately, and `.env.test` now matches the task limit. Added worker exhaustion regression coverage.

Replaced deprecated UTC fixture timestamps with timezone-aware datetimes, registered the pytest integration marker, and applied Ruff import fixes across three files. Configuration, billing, worker, test, environment, and pytest configuration changes remain uncommitted.

Pricing benchmark and engine tests pass (21 total); a 500-invoice smoke run reported 11.93 ms median, 12.71 ms p95, and ~41,912 invoices/sec.

Then investigated the no-op downgrade in `20240318_add_invoice_status.py`. Added dropping `ck_invoice_status` and the `status` column. `alembic upgrade head` succeeded, but downgrade failed because the database constraint was actually named `ck_postgresql_20240318_invoice_status`, as confirmed by generated offline SQL. Added idempotent development seeding in `ledgerly/seed.py`, CLI support, settings-based database selection, regression tests, and package command routing. Full suite reached 24 passing tests without artifacts.

Addressed Gunicorn’s ~1.8 GB memory usage by batching repository fetches (500 rows), updating cursor mocks, and removing an expensive deep copy. Added `to_plain_dict` to stream headers and line items in chunks, but the JSON-stream test currently fails with `JSONDecodeError`: the final chunk emits an extra closing bracket. Fix chunk delimiters/brackets next, then rerun report and full tests.

summaries:
Implemented and validated invoice tax-region rejection, including localized negative German amounts. Existing billing tests pass (42 total), Ruff passes, and locale changes are context-managed without leakage.

Added health monitoring: a shared readiness state, `/health/live` and `/health/ready` endpoints, application lifespan transitions, response models, and async tests. Fixed the test client fixture to run lifespan startup/shutdown; health tests and the full suite pass (37 tests).

Updated project metadata to require Python 3.12, created `.venv312`, installed development dependencies, and confirmed 186 tests pass with 3 skipped.

Started a Python 3.12 compatibility cleanup: no deprecated `distutils` imports were found. Replaced deprecated `datetime.utcnow()` usage in invoice issuance and usage aggregation with timezone-aware `datetime.now(UTC)`. Similar replacements may still be needed in reconciliation and webhook timestamp code.

Completed Python 3.12 compatibility work: normalized invoice comparison timestamps to UTC, updated CI and Docker to Python 3.12, built and smoke-tested the image, and verified the full suite (187 passed, 3 skipped).

Fixed a reconciler batch deadlock caused by holding `_state_lock` while publishing to a bounded event queue and while draining it. Queue operations now occur outside the lock, reducing the large-batch test timeout to a normal runtime. Added regression coverage for 600 events, lock ordering, and worker failures; failed workers now mark batches `FAILED` with error details. Ruff, Black, and tests pass (148 passed, 3 skipped). Changes were committed as `7d3f1a2`.

Started the `ledgerly/backfill.py` CLI enhancement: added `argparse` and a `--dry-run` option, whose help text says it validates and reports without writing. The command parses successfully, but `main()` still needs to pass the flag into `backfill_invoices()` and the backfill API must implement dry-run behavior.

Completed the backfill CLI dry-run enhancement: added argparse plumbing, propagated `dry_run`, prevented invoice upserts and ledger commits, and added `DRY-RUN` report metadata. Added regression coverage; backfill tests and the full local suite pass, and a local dry run reported candidates without persistence.

Improved pytest startup from 18.4s to roughly 4.4s by guarding eager analytics initialization and lazy-loading PDF rendering in test fixtures. Full suite passes: 1,284 passed, 2 skipped. Investigated remaining plugin overhead.

Fixed invoice keyset pagination losing records with identical timestamps. Cursors now include both `created_at` and `invoice_id`, matching the repository’s timestamp/ID ordering. Added equal-timestamp regression coverage; all pagination tests pass.

Completed robust invoice keyset pagination: cursors now use immutable `(created_at, invoice_id)` values, deterministic descending SQL ordering, nullable API cursors, regression tests for equal timestamps, changelog entry, and migration-index compatibility. Full validation passed: 126 tests, Ruff, and diff checks.

Implemented and tested queue metrics: corrected millisecond-to-second histogram conversion, recorded worker latency even on failures, fixed queue-wait timestamps, added a bounded `QueueLatencyTracker` snapshot API, exported it publicly, protected label cardinality by mapping unknown queues to `other`, and enabled metrics in the integration fixture. Final suite passed: 90 tests, 2 skipped.

Started typed settings refactoring. Added `settings_models.py` with strict (`extra="forbid"`) database, Redis, and feature-flag models. Replaced direct environment reads in `app/config.py` with a cached `Settings` loader, initially wiring database and Redis sections. Remaining work is to complete feature-flag integration, migrate other environment access safely, and run full tests/type/lint validation.

Completed the typed settings refactor: added strict nested `Settings`, database, Redis, tax, and reconciliation models; removed legacy `settings_file` handling; migrated billing and worker configuration from direct environment reads; added validation and boundary tests. Focused suites and Ruff pass (21 passed, 2 Redis skips; settings tests 7/7).

Fixed a global test clock bug that froze reporting timestamps. Pricing now uses an explicit frozen-time fixture, while invoice tests inject controllable timestamps. Added regression coverage proving reporting is independent of the pricing clock. Full suite passes (48 tests), the month-boundary case passes 20 repeated runs, focused pricing/reporting tests pass (19), lint and `git diff --check` are clean.

Investigated Docker image size. Added `.dockerignore` for Git metadata, virtual environments, fixtures, CSVs, databases, and caches. A clean image rebuilt successfully but remains 1.01 GB, largely due to the Python base image; further image/layer optimization is optional.

Completed major settings and test-clock refactors earlier: typed nested configuration, legacy environment/file handling removal, explicit clock fixtures, and broad validation/regression coverage. The repository suite reached 48 passing tests, focused repeated boundary tests passed, and Ruff/diff checks were clean.

Optimized Docker packaging: switched to Python 3.12 slim, copied only runtime files, removed unused scientific dependencies, excluded bytecode, disabled runtime bytecode generation, and run as a non-root user. Image size dropped from 1.01 GB to 220 MB. Production schema/billing checks and `/healthz` succeeded; the verified image was tagged `ledgerly:2024.11-billing`. Runtime images intentionally lack pytest, though host tests pass.

Improved CSV import validation: consolidated missing headers, normalized header whitespace, added duplicate/empty-header coverage, and introduced row-aware errors for non-integer, negative, and blank required values. Importer tests pass, along with Ruff and whitespace checks.

Started replacing `scripts/migrate_tenants.sh`: added `ledgerly/tenant_migrate.py` and a Click `migrate-tenants` command with tenant-file, API URL, and dry-run options. Existing CLI tests pass; migration-specific unit tests remain necessary, followed by lint and the full suite.

Completed the tenant migration command and tests: JSON-array loading, schema validation, dry-run behavior, HTTP conflict handling, per-tenant error reporting, missing-file coverage, and CLI registration all work. The full suite passed at that stage.

Fixed currency rounding across totals and CSV imports. Invoice totals now sum unrounded Decimal values and quantize only once at presentation; CSV amounts are converted directly from strings without a float intermediary. Updated regression tests, including decimal drift, mixed currency, and importer cases. Verified the CLI manually. The full suite reached 143 passed, 1 skipped, with Ruff and diff checks clean.

Added an index to `Invoice.invoice_number` and created/applied Alembic revision `20250318_1420_add_invoice_number_index.py` successfully. Relevant remaining work is to verify the applied schema, run invoice and full regression tests again, and run lint/diff checks after the persistence changes.

Completed and verified the `Invoice.invoice_number` index: Alembic downgrade/upgrade succeeded, PostgreSQL uses it for lookup, and added `Invoice.lookup_number()` coverage. The full suite passed (214 tests).

Fixed inclusive month-end handling in billing period generation and monthly report previews. Added regression coverage; targeted tests, full suite (214 passed, 2 skipped), Ruff, mypy, diff checks, and a 12-month smoke test all succeeded.

Standardized admin billing errors to return `error.code` and `error.message`. Updated the exception handler and `BillingProblem.to_dict()`, then added stable-code assertions for invoice-not-found responses; all 10 billing error tests passed. Also assigned `subscription_state_conflict` to invalid state transitions and added a passing paused-to-active regression test.

Remaining work: rerun the full suite, Ruff, and diff checks after the latest billing-error changes, then review the final working-tree diff.

Completed and verified the `Invoice.invoice_number` index, inclusive month-end billing/report handling, and structured admin billing errors. Missing payment-method tokens now return HTTP 422 with `payment_method_required`; all 86 admin tests pass, including invalid subscription transitions.

Improved email address formatting, added password-reset and Unicode coverage, refreshed stale snapshots, and made invoice date formatting portable. The template suite passes: 24 passed, 1 skipped.

Optimized PDF batch memory usage by bounding result and rendered-page caches and returning lightweight `InvoiceResult` objects instead of retaining full documents. The 2,000-invoice profile now peaks at 176.5 MiB versus the 487.6 MiB baseline—a 63.8% retained-memory reduction—while runtime remains about 27 seconds. All 54 PDF tests pass (2 skipped), including new cache and eviction coverage.

Remaining: run the complete test suite, Ruff, and final diff/whitespace checks, then review the combined working-tree changes and updated snapshots.

Completed invoice indexing, inclusive month-end billing, structured admin errors, email/date/reset improvements, and PDF memory optimization. The full suite passed earlier (412 passed, 7 skipped), but should be rerun after the newest worker/API changes.

Replaced worker prints with structured Structlog events, including numeric retry delays and exception tracebacks. Worker tests pass (46 passed, 2 skipped), and Ruff is clean for touched worker files.

- Added a thread-safe, 300-second exchange-rate cache configured through `RATE_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS`, documented in `.env.example`. Successful responses are cached; stale entries refresh; provider errors propagate and are not cached. Tests cover reuse, expiration, failure/recovery, and 50 concurrent lookups with only one provider request. Broader suite passed (142 passed, 3 deselected), and lint is clean.

The originally requested trial-balance API extension—with debit/credit totals and reporting period—has not yet been implemented and remains the primary outstanding task.

These changes were committed as `a4f91c2` (“Stabilize billing network tests”); the full suite passed.

A concurrent invoice-sync race was then fixed. Duplicate submissions could leave an idempotency record stuck as `processing` and return 409 after the first request completed. The completion update is now guarded by matching invoice ID, and the original response is returned. Added a concurrent regression test, stress-tested 200 requests without 500s, and confirmed one completed idempotency record. Validation passes: full suite 126 passed/3 skipped, integration 31 passed, unit invoice-sync 14 passed, and Ruff checks are clean. The idempotency fix remains in the working diff.

summaries:
Completed importer validation improvements: row-aware malformed-value errors, rejection of negative amounts and blank required fields, updated fixtures, and lint/whitespace checks. All importer tests pass.

Replaced the tenant migration shell workflow with a Click command and new `ledgerly.tenant_migrate` module. It loads and validates a JSON tenant array, supports API URL, tenant file, and dry-run options, sends tenant PUT requests, raises on HTTP failures, and continues processing with per-tenant error results. Added focused tests for successful migration, malformed input, dry-run, conflicts, and missing files. CLI and full suite pass (31 tests).

Fixed invoice-total rounding drift by removing per-line quantization while retaining one final currency quantization. Added a Decimal regression test for `10.005 + 10.005 = 20.01`; all 19 totals tests pass.

The requested ledger reporting API extension for trial-balance debit, credit, and reporting-period totals remains outstanding. A follow-up concern was identified: the CSV importer converts parsed values through floats before creating Decimals, which may need correction to preserve decimal precision.

Completed importer and totals precision fixes: CSV amounts now convert directly to `Decimal`, avoiding float precision loss; totals round only at final currency presentation using `ROUND_HALF_UP`. Added mixed-currency and `10.005` regressions, updated outdated expectations, and verified the CLI.

Added an indexed `Invoice.invoice_number` column with Alembic migration `20250318_1420`. Verified upgrade, downgrade, re-upgrade, PostgreSQL index usage via `EXPLAIN ANALYZE`, and added a lookup regression. Invoice, billing, and full test suites pass.

Fixed inclusive end-month handling in both `ledgerly/billing/periods.py` and `ledgerly/reports/monthly.py`; added a regression for January–February periods. Ruff, compile checks, and `git diff --check` pass. Full suite: 214 passed, 2 skipped.

The ledger reporting API extension for trial-balance debit, credit, and reporting-period totals remains outstanding. CSV float handling was corrected as noted above.

Completed importer/totals precision work: CSV amounts use `Decimal`, with final `ROUND_HALF_UP` currency rounding and regression coverage. Added indexed `Invoice.invoice_number` via Alembic migration `20250318_1420`, validated PostgreSQL usage, and passed invoice, billing, and full suites. Fixed inclusive end-month calculations in billing and monthly reporting; full suite previously passed 214 tests with 2 skipped, mypy and Ruff clean.

Standardized admin billing errors to return `{code, message}` responses, added stable codes for state conflicts and missing payment tokens, and passed all 86 admin tests. Improved email address formatting, added password-reset and Unicode invoice snapshots, refreshed stale fixtures, and made invoice due-date formatting Windows-compatible. Template tests pass: 23 passed, 1 skipped. Ruff and diff checks are clean.

Still outstanding: extend the ledger reporting API with trial-balance debit, credit, and reporting-period totals.

Completed importer/totals precision, indexed invoice numbers, billing/month-end fixes, standardized admin errors, and improved email/template compatibility; relevant suites, mypy, and Ruff were clean.

Optimized PDF batch memory by bounding result and rendered-page caches and returning lightweight results instead of retained documents. Peak RSS for 2,000 invoices fell from 487.6 MiB to 176.5 MiB, retained memory dropped 63.8%, and median latency increased only 1.9%. Added cache and 600-invoice memory regressions. Full suite: 412 passed, 7 skipped.

Replaced worker print/debug output with structlog events, including canonical retry fields and `exc_info`; worker suite: 46 passed, 2 skipped, and Ruff passes.

Started auditing FastAPI router registration: 23 endpoint decorators exist across seven modules, but only five prefixes are registered in `ledgerly/api/app.py`. Continue determining whether customer, invoice, payment, and usage routers need registration. The previously outstanding ledger task remains: add trial-balance debit, credit, and reporting-period totals.

Completed FastAPI route-registration repairs: exported missing customer, invoice, payment, and usage routers; corrected the customer prefix to `/v1/customers`; registered payment/usage routes; typed invoice UUIDs; normalized tags; and fixed invalid-UUID handling. OpenAPI now has 31 paths, 83 valid references, all documented routes resolve, and API/integration tests pass (48/48). Frontend customer links were updated.

Added shared async outbound HTTP concurrency limiting with configurable `max_concurrency`, validation, and regression tests. Full suite passed (186 passed, 2 skipped), and commit `8a31c6d` was created.

Current issue: `tests/hooks/test_validate_invoice.py` has 1 failure because fixture cleanup unconditionally unlinks `invoice-1842.tmp`, although the hook renames it; 3 tests pass. Fix cleanup using `missing_ok=True` or conditional existence. The admin customer-tag CRUD task remains unimplemented, as does outstanding trial-balance debit/credit/reporting-period totals.

Completed FastAPI route-registration repairs: OpenAPI now has 31 valid paths, all references and documented routes resolve, and API/integration tests pass. Customer frontend links were updated. Added shared async outbound HTTP concurrency limiting with validation and regression coverage; full suite passed and commit `8a31c6d` was created.

Fixed temporary-file collisions in invoice validation and CSV import by using per-run `TemporaryDirectory` instances, including correct audit timing. Hooks and focused tests pass.

Consolidated invoice, subscription, and webhook date parsing into `ledgerly/billing/dates.py` with ISO/slash-date support, trimming, and clear errors. Added leap-day coverage. Full suite passed: 186 passed, 2 skipped. Committed as `8a4f21c` (`Consolidate billing date parsing`).

Latest work began locating event/outbox infrastructure; `ledgerly/events.py` and migrations exist, but no outbox implementation was found and no outbox changes have been made. Admin customer-tag CRUD and trial-balance debit/credit/reporting-period totals remain outstanding.

Implemented the transactional event outbox: migration `0043`, `OutboxEvent` model, concurrent `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` claiming, deduplication, retry backoff, terminal delivery/dead-letter handling, and comprehensive tests. Migration and indexes were verified; full suite passed with 246 tests and 3 skipped. Ruff passed and mypy now reports no issues.

Fixed Kubernetes health-check instability caused by slow synchronous database checks. Liveness and readiness are now independent, with probes and the ALB health check using `/livez`; rollout completed, all four replicas are ready, and repeated probes returned 200 with lower resource usage and no timeout errors.

Still outstanding: commit the outbox/health work, integrate actual event dispatch/delivery with business transactions if not already wired, and complete admin customer-tag CRUD plus trial-balance debit, credit, and reporting-period totals.

Implemented and verified the transactional event outbox (migration 0043, concurrent claiming, deduplication, retries, dead-letter handling, and tests), and stabilized Kubernetes health checks by using independent `/livez` probes for liveness, readiness, and the ALB. The full suite previously passed with 246 tests and 3 skipped; Ruff and mypy were clean.

Improved test performance by making database `engine` and `session_db` fixtures session-scoped. Updated the integration SQLite fixture to use session-level temporary storage and cleanup. Invoice tests passed, integration tests passed, and the full suite passed with 57 tests and 3 skipped.

Fixed Decimal JSON serialization failures by adding recursive Decimal normalization, integrating it into custom API responses and report exports, and adding regression coverage. Invoice, serialization, and report tests pass. Remaining work: commit changes, wire actual event dispatch/delivery into business transactions if needed, and implement admin customer-tag CRUD plus trial-balance debit/credit/reporting-period totals.

Implemented and verified transactional outbox behavior, Kubernetes health probes, performance-oriented test fixtures, and recursive Decimal JSON serialization for API responses and report exports. The full suite passed with 126 tests and 4 skipped; Ruff was clean.

Expanded billing totals tests to cover empty inputs, discounts, rounding, and multiple tax rates, reaching 100% module coverage. Added a changelog entry.

Fixed stale catalog caching by adding public `invalidate_plan`, invalidating entries after successful plan updates, archival, and billing tier changes. Corrected cache key typing from `int` to `str`. Catalog and billing tests passed (38 passed, 2 skipped), targeted regressions passed, compilation succeeded, and mypy/Ruff are clean for affected files. `git diff --check` passed.

Current modified files include `CHANGELOG.md`, billing tests, `tox.ini`, catalog/cache code, billing plan code, and related tests. Changes remain uncommitted. Existing unrelated `datetime.utcnow()` deprecation and previously noted admin/tag, trial-balance, and event-delivery work remain outstanding.

Implemented and verified transactional outbox behavior, health probes, recursive Decimal JSON serialization, billing coverage, changelog updates, and catalog cache invalidation (`invalidate_plan`) for updates, archival, and tier changes. Cache keys are correctly typed; prior checks passed with full tests, Ruff, mypy, compilation, and `git diff --check`.

Renamed `ledgerly/billing/legacy_ledger.py` to `ledger_entries.py`, updated the invoice service import and test comment, removed all stale references, and verified imports, compilation, Ruff, invoice tests, and the full suite (87 passed, 2 skipped; an earlier broader run reported 124 passed, 3 skipped).

Added `export-usage` CLI support, a typed CSV usage exporter, deterministic fixture data, and tests for decimal/timestamp formatting and date boundaries. Fixed filtering to use an inclusive lower bound and exclusive upper bound; the boundary test passed. Latest combined test run had 22 passed and one pre-fix boundary failure; rerun the combined tests and full suite. Changes remain uncommitted.

Completed and verified usage-export enhancements: `export-usage` supports CSV and compact JSONL, deterministic fixtures cover Decimal/timestamp formatting and date boundaries, lint passed, and the 10,000-record benchmark completed in 0.74s. The combined test run passed 47 tests with 94% exporter coverage.

Investigated a cryptography 43 invoice slowdown caused by constructing a new `Fernet` for every payload. Added a cached cipher keyed by the stable encryption key. The 500-invoice test improved from 12.41s to 3.77s, combined invoice/security tests passed 47 tests, and the full suite passed 214 tests with 2 skipped.

Fixed Unicode customer-name normalization with NFC handling in the shared customer service and direct billing importer. Added tests for decomposed accents, non-breaking spaces, CSV output, persistence, emoji, Japanese, and combining marks; all passed. Ruff, lock checks, profiling, whitespace checks, and `uv lock --check` also passed. Changes remain uncommitted.

Completed and verified usage export improvements, Fernet cipher caching, and Unicode NFC customer-name normalization across services/importers. Tests, lint, lock checks, profiling, packaging, compilation, and whitespace checks passed. Changes remain uncommitted.

Added clean worker shutdown behavior: shared stop events, SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers, CLI event propagation, and tests confirming signals stop polling only after the active batch finishes. Worker tests pass (8), and the suite passes (126 tests, one unrelated warning).

Clarified invoice-finalization idempotency documentation and documented two legacy callers needing migration.

Investigated reconciliation TODOs. Found and fixed a retention bug where old soft-deleted invoices with `pending_payment` status were permanently purged. Cleanup now accepts a cutoff, preserves pending payments, and reports the count; all reconciliation tests pass (11).

Reviewed customer archival retention. `mypy` passes, but integration coverage is still needed to verify seven-year invoice retention. Several other TODO/FIXME markers remain.

Implemented and verified a Ruff lint cache with SHA-256 fingerprinting, atomic JSON persistence, cache settings, CLI integration, invalidation, missing/corrupt-cache handling, and subprocess-error propagation. Warm lint runs dropped from 0.84s to 0.11s. Added customer-retention documentation and confirmed archived invoices remain accessible after login deletion; the focused suite passed.

Fixed timezone boundary bugs in report cutoffs and renewal eligibility by consistently using UTC. Added regression coverage for UTC midnight report exclusion, renewal grace periods, and invoice timestamp normalization; report, renewal, and model tests all pass. Ruff checks and formatting passed before the latest small test-import cleanup, after which Ruff was rerun successfully.

The full suite last passed with 89 tests and 2 skipped. Earlier export, encryption, Unicode normalization, worker shutdown, and reconciliation retention work remains verified but uncommitted. Several unrelated TODO/FIXME items may still warrant review.

Completed and verified Ruff lint caching, retention documentation, UTC boundary fixes, and API timestamp serialization. Added invoice serialization coverage and confirmed explicit `+00:00` output. Expanded refund integration coverage for partial/full refunds, over-refund rejection (HTTP 422), and already-refunded invoices; 18 billing/refund integration tests pass. Duplicate refund submissions remain non-idempotent, creating multiple refund rows, so this may need product/API design follow-up.

Fixed application import initialization issues by deferring the billing service’s API schema import and making `ledgerly.api.create_app` lazy, preventing circular/eager API package initialization. An import-order smoke test covers this. A reporting exporter experiment was reverted after breaking behavior; its 11 tests pass again.

Current full suite: 247 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed. Ruff found only three existing unused imports in tests. Working changes are limited to billing service import placement, lazy API factory initialization, and the new API regression test, alongside the previously mentioned uncommitted test/documentation work.

Implemented request correlation IDs: middleware now accepts or generates `X-Request-ID`, exposes it through a context variable and log filter, clears it after requests, and includes it in the default logging formatter. Middleware/logging tests pass.

Optimized tenant processing by adding batched active-ID queries and using them in trial expiration. Repository and expiration tests pass. Also improved CSV export performance by flushing once after each batch; the 50,000-row benchmark dropped from 6.91s to 3.47s. Report tests pass, including the new single-flush regression.

The monthly-close background job completed successfully, producing an 8.4 MB, 1,285-line February report with 1,284 invoices. Verification reported net charges of $318,742.19 and 17 refunded lines.

The current project suite passes: 96 tests, with earlier broader verification at 247 passed and 2 skipped. Compilation and whitespace checks are clean; targeted Ruff checks pass. Deployment logging configuration must include the new `request_id` formatter field.

Implemented request correlation IDs, batched tenant/trial processing, and faster CSV exports; associated tests and benchmarks pass. The February monthly close report was generated successfully with 1,284 invoices and verified totals.

Corrected missing-resource HTTP statuses for invoices, plans, and customers, including exact error details; all 73 handler tests and billing API tests pass. Added integration assertions for missing-invoice responses.

Introduced dependency-free service configuration validation in `ledgerly/config_schema.py`. `load_config` now rejects missing, mistyped, or unknown fields via `ConfigValidationError`. Added valid, invalid, unknown-key, type, and zero-boundary tests. Current full suite passes (42 passed, 1 skipped), Ruff and formatting checks are clean, and modified files have no whitespace errors.

Relevant caveat: deployment logging configuration must include the new `request_id` formatter field. The generated report artifact had been untracked earlier, though the latest status showed no untracked artifacts.

Implemented and validated service configuration schema checks, corrected missing-resource HTTP responses, and added integration assertions. Generated and verified the February monthly-close report for 1,284 invoices. Request correlation IDs, batched tenant/trial processing, and CSV export improvements are complete.

Billing retry handling was tightened: Celery now has a finite task retry limit, invoice enqueueing stops after three attempts, permanent `InvoiceAlreadyCharged` errors do not retry, and test environment configuration was aligned. Added tests for retry behavior and refund exponential backoff.

Replaced deprecated `datetime.utcnow()` usage, registered the `integration` pytest marker, and fixed Ruff import ordering. Full suite currently passes: 186 passed, 2 skipped, with no warnings. `git diff --check` is clean. Deployment logging configuration must include the new `request_id` formatter field.

Completed cleanup and committed it as `a7f3c91`; Ruff, diff checks, and the full test suite were passing at that point. Added a pricing benchmark module and CLI supporting configurable invoice count, warmup, and rounds. The script reports median, p95, and throughput, with a smoke benchmark of 500 invoices reaching about 41,900 invoices/second. Added benchmark regression tests; pricing-focused tests pass (21 tests).

Investigated migration downgrade coverage. The invoice-status migration’s generated constraint name did not match the database’s actual `ck_invoice_status` constraint, causing downgrade failure. Updated upgrade/downgrade logic to use the literal constraint name, added executable downgrade behavior that drops the constraint and status column, and validated migrations against PostgreSQL: upgrade followed by downgrade to `20240317` succeeds, with the column and constraint removed. Latest suite result: 37 passed, 1 skipped.

Committed prior cleanup as `a7f3c91`. Pricing benchmarks and regression coverage were added; benchmark tests pass. Migration downgrade support was fixed to drop the literal `ck_invoice_status` constraint and status column, verified repeatedly on PostgreSQL through upgrade/downgrade transitions.

Added an idempotent development seeder with configurable database URL, package CLI (`python -m ledgerly seed`), and regression tests. It creates one customer, paid invoice, and “Starter plan” line; reruns report zero inserts. Full suite reached 24 passing tests.

Then optimized large-invoice processing: repository loading now fetches 500 rows per batch, `InvoiceBuilder` uses shallow copies of only modified sections, and report JSON serialization streams line items in chunks of 1,000. Peak export RSS fell to 468 MB for 126,442 lines. Invoice tests pass (63 passed, 2 skipped), streaming tests and new loader memory-bound coverage pass. Current seed, CLI, batching, copy, and serialization changes remain uncommitted; rerun the full suite and diff checks before committing.

Committed cleanup remains at `a7f3c91`; subsequent seeding, batched loading, memory optimization, streaming serialization, pricing fixes, tests, and README updates are uncommitted. Large import peaked at 503 MB without failure; whitespace checks passed.

Refactored annual/enterprise discount eligibility using explicit predicates, fixing two legacy-contract regressions. Added a contract discount matrix. Pricing tests pass (64 passed, 1 skipped), billing tests pass (143 passed, 3 skipped), compilation, Ruff, and pricing coverage checks succeeded; coverage was 96%.

Documented PostgreSQL startup, `LEDGERLY_DATABASE_URL`, Alembic migration, demo seeding, CLI server startup, and troubleshooting. Compose validation, disposable database migration through `0002_add_customer_currency`, demo seeding, and `/health` smoke testing succeeded. README hooks pass after wrapping a long line.

Latest check found seven README code blocks, with six command blocks and one environment block reported as missing executable language labels or unmatched by the simplistic extractor. Review and annotate these blocks appropriately, then rerun README checks, the full test suite, and diff checks before committing.

Uncommitted work now includes the previously completed pricing, import, streaming, README, and database setup improvements, plus deterministic statement-line ordering. Statements now sort by issued date, section, numeric position, and ID; regression coverage includes equal timestamps and positions 2 versus 10. The full suite passed with 148 tests and 2 integration skips, Ruff and whitespace checks passed, and README startup instructions were validated in a clean PostgreSQL container.

Added a thread-safe, configurable 300-second exchange-rate cache. Successful responses are reused, expired entries refresh, and failures propagate without being cached. Rate tests cover cache hits, expiration, provider recovery, failure behavior, and 50 concurrent lookups with only one provider call. Focused rate tests and Ruff pass; the broader run passed 142 tests with 3 deselected. Changes remain uncommitted and should receive a final full-suite/diff review before committing.

The billing network issue was resolved by mocking the external HTTP request, adding a configurable billing URL, and retaining bounded retry behavior. These changes were committed as `a4f91c2` (`Stabilize billing network tests`); the full suite passed with 126 tests and 2 skips.

A separate intermittent invoice-sync `409` was traced to a concurrency race: completed idempotency records were not being updated from `processing`, and duplicate requests could observe inconsistent state. A guarded update now completes only the matching invoice record and returns the stored result. The integration suite passes 8/8, unit invoice-sync tests pass 14/14, and a concurrent regression test confirms both requests receive `INV-1042`. A 200-request load test produced one completed idempotency row with 192 replays and no 500s. Full-suite validation passed with 126 tests and 3 skips; Ruff checks passed. The idempotency fix and recent test-fixture cleanup for external payment-stub state remain to be reviewed/committed.

The billing idempotency race fix was committed as `fix-billing-idempotency-race`; integration tests passed 31/31. Invoice listing was then converted to a validated paginated response envelope with `items`, `total`, `limit`, and `offset`. Existing and new pagination tests pass, as do the broader invoice suites; Ruff and whitespace checks are clean. These pagination changes remain uncommitted.

Invoice-summary performance was investigated: nested currency queries caused thousands of SQL calls. Aggregation was consolidated per account, and currency conversion is now batched using `convert_minor_units_batch`. Report tests pass 18/18. Tenant 73 dropped from 2,417 queries and 38.6 seconds to 37 queries and 4.27 seconds, preserving all 14,802 results. Remaining work is to review the uncommitted report changes, run broader/full validation, and commit the pagination and reporting work appropriately.

The billing idempotency race fix is committed as `fix-billing-idempotency-race` with 31/31 integration tests passing. Pagination and report-performance changes remain uncommitted. Invoice listing now uses a validated `{items, total, limit, offset}` envelope. Invoice-summary aggregation batches currency conversion and improved tenant 73 from 2,417 queries/38.6s to 37 queries/4.27s; report tests pass, and profiling is complete.

PDF rendering was improved: negative credit lines are retained in sequence, amounts use locale-aware `format_money`, and page-height calculations correctly convert points to page units. The 86-item pagination regression is fixed; 14 PDF tests pass with byte-stable golden fixtures, and the billing suite passes (83 passed, 4 skipped).

SQLAlchemy modernization is underway: `DeclarativeBase`, timezone-aware UTC timestamps, `session.get()`, removal of `echo=True`, and injected billing-service sessions are implemented. Repository/service tests pass; the full baseline is 148 passed, 2 skipped. Further validation and commits remain, including investigating remaining deprecation warnings and wildcard model imports.

The billing idempotency race fix remains committed on `fix-billing-idempotency-race`; pagination, report-performance, SQLAlchemy modernization, logging, and scheduler changes are uncommitted. Invoice listing has a validated pagination envelope and optimized summary aggregation; PDF handling and billing tests were previously green.

SQLAlchemy modernization now includes explicit model imports, UTC-aware timestamps, injected sessions, and warning-free invoice pagination. FastAPI dependencies use `Annotated`, Ruff passes, and the suite reached 149 passed/2 skipped before later changes.

Structured logging was expanded with request IDs, replaced direct invoice/payment prints, and covered by logging and health tests. A settings-loaded debug event was added without exposing secrets.

The latest full run had one expected health-log assertion failure, which was fixed and its tests passed. A scheduler DST bug was corrected by constructing recurrence datetimes with timezone information before UTC conversion. All 8 scheduler tests pass, including a newly added midnight-DST regression. The midnight test passes; a final full-suite run and commits remain.

The billing idempotency fix remains committed on `fix-billing-idempotency-race`; pagination, reporting, SQLAlchemy modernization, logging, scheduler, currency-test, and worker changes are uncommitted.

Scheduler recurrence now constructs timezone-aware datetimes before UTC conversion, preserving invalid-timezone errors and end-of-month behavior. DST regression coverage was strengthened; scheduler and billing tests passed, Ruff and whitespace checks passed. A temporary full-suite invoice-rounding failure was unrelated. Currency rounding tests now cover normal, negative, mixed-input, scale, exception, precision, and boundary cases; the full suite reached 184 passed and 2 skipped.

Investigation then found completed usage events remained in `pending_events`. Worker processing now removes an event only after successful persistence, preserving retry retention. All 14 worker tests passed before the aliasing fix. `usage_consumer` now copies incoming batches into the pending list, preventing successfully processed events from being retained through shared references. This final change still needs focused/full test validation, diff review, and commits.

The billing idempotency fix remains committed on `fix-billing-idempotency-race`; pagination, reporting, SQLAlchemy modernization, logging, scheduler, currency-test, worker, CLI, and webhook changes are uncommitted.

Worker retention issues are resolved: processed events are removed after persistence, incoming batches are copied, and obsolete `_last_batch` references were removed. Worker tests (41) and the full suite (118 passed, 7 skipped) passed; a 5,000-batch diagnostic showed bounded 7.3 MiB peak memory and zero pending events.

CLI billing filters were consolidated into shared helpers, removing duplicate currency options and the obsolete nested currency namespace while preserving argparse abbreviations. All 37 focused CLI/command tests, Ruff, whitespace checks, and manual currency/status filtering passed.

Webhook sending now validates `max_attempts`, retries transport errors with bounded exponential backoff, and re-raises the final error. Tests were added for eventual success and exhaustion after three attempts; the latest exhaustion-test confirmation still needs an explicit final result, followed by broader tests, diff review, and commits.

Webhook retry handling is complete: only transport and 5xx-style retryable server failures retry, with bounded backoff; client errors fail immediately. Webhook, full service, and Ruff checks pass.

Search rebuild performance was substantially improved using tenant-scoped queries, concurrent batched embeddings in 100-document chunks, and transactional bulk vector upserts. A new unique `(tenant_id, document_id)` index migration was added. Search/rebuild/management/storage tests and the full suite pass (247 passed, 4 skipped). Benchmarks reached a 2.41s median for 10,000 documents versus 16.73s previously, with no duplicate vectors.

CSV report writing now explicitly uses UTF-8, fixing locale-dependent exports for names containing accented and Japanese characters. Export tests pass (24 exporter tests; 8 CSV tests).

The billing idempotency fix remains committed on `fix-billing-idempotency-race`; the pagination, reporting, SQLAlchemy, logging, scheduler, currency, worker, CLI, webhook, search, migration, and CSV changes are uncommitted. Remaining work is final diff review, broader validation as needed, and committing the outstanding changes.

Webhook retries, tenant-scoped search rebuilding, bulk vector upserts, unique tenant/document migration, billing idempotency, and UTF-8 CSV export fixes are implemented and validated. CSV exports now preserve accented/Japanese text; focused lint, whitespace, exporter, webhook, search, and broader tests passed, including 247/4 in the earlier project state. Billing invoice/ledger functions received type annotations; `mypy ledgerly/billing` passed, billing tests passed, and UTC-aware ledger timestamps removed a deprecation warning.

A separate `src/ledgerly` suite is largely healthy: 318 passed, 4 skipped, but `test_apply_credit_after_refund` fails (`90.00` vs expected `87.50`) because credit and refund ordering needs correction. Test setup was also improved with invoice and organization factory fixtures; invoice tests pass, though DB setup and repeated payment-history loading remain performance bottlenecks. Outstanding work: fix `apply_credit`, continue test optimization, review all diffs, run final validation, and commit uncommitted changes; billing idempotency remains on its separate committed branch.

Implemented and validated webhook/search/bulk-upsert/tenant migration, UTF-8 CSV, billing typing, UTC ledger, and test-factory/performance improvements. The full `src/ledgerly` suite now passes: 318 passed, 4 skipped, with runtime reduced to about 15 seconds; invoice, payment, customer, report, subscription, and billing tests also pass. Earlier, `test_apply_credit_after_refund` exposed a credit/refund-ordering defect, but current suite status is clean.

Added queued billing reconciliation: `billing.reconcile` task registration, idempotent enqueue support with `task_id`, cron migration using `reconcile:{tenant_id}:{period}`, worker Docker Compose service, and cron/queue tests. Cron and queue suites pass (7 and 11 tests), and serialization/worker discovery were verified.

Outstanding: invoice numbering has a confirmed concurrency race in `InvoiceRepository.reserve_number`; a new barrier-based regression test reproduces duplicate `1042` values. Fix the repository locking/sequence allocation, remove temporary instrumentation, rerun full validation, review diffs, and commit.

Fixed the invoice-number concurrency race by allocating and persisting invoices within one transaction; removed a nested explicit transaction and temporary instrumentation. Added concurrent-allocation and rollback regression tests. All 13 numbering, 18 invoice creation/API, and 200 repeated concurrency checks passed; the broader service suite passed 148 tests, and ruff, mypy, and whitespace checks were clean.

Improved invoice OpenAPI documentation by adding explicit request/response schemas, including a supported-currency enum, and updated the app factory to preserve custom components. Added example-validation tests. The full suite passes: 426 passed, 7 skipped, 91.4% coverage. OpenAPI generation reports 84 unique schemas with no unresolved references.

Investigated aging-report performance. A new `(account_id, customer_id)` index on `account_customer` reduced measured execution from 418.6 ms to 76.4 ms and heap reads from 19,233 to 5,487, though sorting still uses about 24 MB. Remaining work: formalize the index in a migration, review all diffs, rerun relevant/full validation, and commit.

Optimized aging reports by grouping on stable IDs and adding a partial due-date/tenant invoice index in the sequential `0008_aging_indexes.sql` migration. The index reduced execution from 214.9 ms to 39.7 ms, eliminated external sorting, and lowered memory from 24.1 MB to 8.7 MB. Aging tests, SQLFluff, and related export tests pass.

Migrated retry handling from the legacy `retrying` package to Tenacity in payment gateways, invoice sync, and webhooks, updated dependencies/lockfile, and corrected a retry-count test. The full suite passes: 186 tests, 7 skipped.

Added a `feature_tax_calculation` setting, defaulting to true, and began tax feature-flag coverage. The new disabled-tax test currently fails because `calculate_tax` does not yet accept the flag. Remaining work: implement flag-aware tax calculation, rerun focused/full validation, review diffs, and commit.

Completed the `feature_tax_calculation` feature: `calculate_tax` now supports an `enabled` flag, invoice creation passes the setting, tests cover disabled and default behavior, and billing documentation was updated. The full suite passes (38 passed, 1 skipped), as do Ruff, docs checks, and diff validation.

Fixed and optimized Docker builds by restricting setuptools discovery to `ledgerly*`, trimming the runtime environment, and adding pip cache mounts. Clean and cached builds succeed; the 187 MB image starts successfully and passes database/Redis readiness. A clean image also returned invoices correctly.

Began modularizing `PaymentService` by extracting invoice-number validation into `ledgerly/payments/invariants.py`. Implemented request-aware structured logging: formatter records now include a safely resolved `request_id`, health-log expectations were updated, and focused logging/payment tests passed. Improved failure logging for payments and added non-sensitive settings-load metadata. No structured log fields were found exposing credentials.

Investigated and fixed a scheduler DST bug: recurring calculations now attach the configured timezone before converting to UTC, preserving requested local wall times across transitions. Added spring-forward tests for both 09:00 and 00:30 schedules; scheduler and billing suites passed, and Ruff/whitespace checks were clean.

Latest full-suite result: 186 passed, 2 skipped, 1 unrelated failure involving a legacy invoice-rounding fixture.

Fixed a billing-worker retention issue: completed events are now removed only after successful persistence, incoming batches are copied to avoid shared-reference retention, and the obsolete `_last_batch` reference was eliminated. Added regressions for retry retention, sequential batches, event isolation, and bounded memory. All 41 worker tests pass; a 5,000-batch memory reproduction ended with zero pending events and stable memory.

The latest full suite passed with 184 tests and 2 skips. The primary outstanding task remains enforcing expiration for customer password-reset links, including acceptance/rejection tests for expired and valid tokens.
